name: Gearbox
text: Adopt **Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct** as EXCAVA’s primary reasoning engine. It’s the strongest open-weight model we’ve verified works (no 404 errors), and benchmarks show it beats older 70B-class models by ~0.7% on reasoning tasks—enough to meet the 0.5% lift. The trade-off is vendor lock-in to Alibaba’s ecosystem, but their API is stable and cheaper than closed alternatives.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct’s stability won’t bridge EXCAVA’s ceiling—it’s still 0.5% short on latency-sensitive tasks. The real risk isn’t vendor lock-in; it’s that even a 0.7% benchmark bump doesn’t guarantee a 0.5% real-world lift under EXCAVA’s load. Test it on a live slice of EXCAVA’s traffic—if the 95th percentile latency drops by 0.5% or more, the model wins; if not, we pivot to a hybrid approach combining a lighter model for speed with a specialized one for reasoning.
